snippet.title: Bru & Boegie: Episode 1 - Get da MILK! [Launch Trailer]
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3711090/

‘Bru & Boegie: Episode 1 - Get da MILK!’ is a hand-drawn 2D surrealist comedy point-and-click adventure game.

You are Bru. You need milk for your coffee. YOH. The stakes are hectic.
Slip into the underpants of Bru, a strange stoic man-child with a mission: get milk for da coffee. Point and click your way through a fully hand-drawn and animated world, featuring a fully-voiced cast and an original soundtrack.
Inspired by classic point-and-click adventures like 'Sam & Max: Hit the Road' and 'Day of the Tentacle', this puzzle adventure serves up a healthy dose of ridiculousness that can be completed in a single sitting.

Features:
• One-Button Gameplay: So intuitive, even an Ouma can master it!
• Interactions deluxe: More unique interactions than you can shake a stick at.
• Rarefied Humour: Enjoy bizarre characters, non sequiturs and irreverent small-batch bespoke conspiracy theories.
• Original Hand-Drawn Art & Animation: Made by human hands - nice.
• Fully-Human Voiced Cast: Almost 1,000 dialogue entries, all fully-voiced by real people.
• Original Music Score: Catchy tunes to make you feel kiff.
• Mini-Games! Stop the intrusive thoughts from infiltrating your mind in 'Meditation HERO', and collect all 15 stickers scattered around the world to unlock a surprise!
• You Can’t Die: Low stress, plenty lols.

I'm an indie creator from South Africa, this is my first substantial indie game release, the first episode in what I plan to be a trilogy of Bru & Boegie episodes. 

https://www.MIKDOG.com
